title: End of Season Presentation BBQ
body: Our annual presentation and bbq will take place on Saturday, March 28th at the rec. All players, parents, and coaches are welcome. Trophies will be awarded across all age groups. More details to follow.

title: U12 Recruiting for 2026/27 Season
body: We are currently recruiting for U12s ahead of the 2026/27 season. If your child is interested, please contact James at u12panthers@glenvillajuniors.co.uk to register.
